Metadata.summary: Their mission is simple: Find a cure. Stop the virus. Save the world. When a global pandemic wipes out eighty percent of the planet's population, the crew of a lone naval destroyer must find a way to pull humanity from the brink of extinction.
Metadata.tagline: No cure. No country. No surrender. (Season 1)
Metadata.title: The Last Ship

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Tense post-apocalyptic thriller is violent and scary.
